explanation: Merged main (#30, #31, #34) into the bundle-reader branch. From this branch: bundleReader.test.ts pins the writer-to-reader round trip, strict JSONP parsing and registry unit precedence; bundleReaderParity.test.ts pins Node reader labels to loadDatasetMeta for every committed meta.js; agentExport.test.ts reads published bytes through readJsonp and asserts the reviewed GSE174085 label. From main: expressionSurvey.test.ts, expressionSurveyLoad.test.tsx and expressionSurveyView.test.tsx cover survey derivation and per-source retry, sourceJson.test.ts the shared expression-source reader, and explorerSession.test.tsx the analysis snapshot defaults.
